user.title: Connect to Paxton10
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reaches the Paxton10 server. Use Direct when Home Assistant is on the site network.

data_description.route: Direct connects to the server's address. Remote goes through Paxton's remote access service.

data_description.target: For Direct, the server's IP address or host name, for example 192.0.2.10. For Remote, the remote ID from the paxton10remote.com address, for example abc123.

account.title: Paxton account
account.description: Use a dedicated Paxton account for Home Assistant, so the Paxton event log shows its actions.

data_description.username: The email address of the Paxton10 account.
data_description.password: Home Assistant stores only the password hash that the Paxton10 server expects.

confirm.title: Add {name}?

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The Paxton10 server rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

data_description.username: The email address of the Paxton10 account.

data_description.route: Direct connects to the server's address. Remote goes through Paxton's remote access service.

data_description.target: For Direct, the server's IP address or host name. For Remote, the remote ID.

error.invalid_auth: The username or password is wrong.
error.cannot_connect: Can't connect to the Paxton10 server.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Paxton10 site is already set up.
abort.wrong_site: That server is a different Paxton10 site.

data_description.allow_door_control: Adds an Open button for each door and the gate. When off, Home Assistant sends no writes at all.
data_description.device_interval: How often to read controller and entry panel status.
data_description.event_interval: How often to read the event log. Minimum 5 seconds.
data_description.fallback: If the configured route fails, try the other one ({other_route}).
data_description.fallback_target: The address or remote ID for the {other_route} route.
data_description.include_user_names: Adds residents' names to door events. This is personal data, so it's off by default.

error.fallback_target_required: Enter the fallback address or remote ID.

invalid_auth.message: The Paxton10 server rejected the stored credentials.

cannot_connect.message: Can't connect to the Paxton10 server: {error}

door_gone.message: This door is no longer on the Paxton10 server.

door_control_off.message: Door control is off in the Paxton10 options.

door_forbidden.message: The Paxton account isn't allowed to open {door}.

using_fallback_route.title: Paxton10 is using the fallback route
using_fallback_route.description: The configured {primary} route failed, so Home Assistant is connected over {active}. Check the network path to the Paxton10 server. This message clears when the {primary} route works again.
